rows.system_rule: Keep connector and local app-server boundaries explicit and least-privilege.
Make receipts operationally useful without publishing raw runtime material.
Separate stable runner defaults from prerelease watch signals.

checklist: No raw lane text in public receipts.
No raw app transport in public receipts.
No local absolute paths in public receipts.
No connector writes without separate approval.
No phase advance without all required lane gates.
